_comment: ECS Fargate task definition for the KairoX API. TEMPLATE — every TODO is a
value only you have, and nothing here has been applied to an AWS account.
THE SAME IMAGE runs api, worker and beat; only `command` differs, which is
what entrypoint.sh already dispatches on. Copy this file for the other two
and change the command, the cpu/memory, and drop the portMappings.
SECRETS ARE REFERENCED, NOT INLINED. Anything in `environment` is readable
by anyone who can call ecs:DescribeTaskDefinition, which is a much wider
set of people than you think. Connection strings and SECRET_KEY go in
_sizing_comment: 1 vCPU / 2GB is a starting point, not a measurement. This app is IO-bound
on the database: CPU stays low while the connection pool saturates. Scale
on ALBRequestCountPerTarget, not CPU, and raise DB_POOL_SIZE before adding
taskRoleArn: TODO: arn:aws:iam::<account>:role/kairoxTaskRole (needs s3:GetObject/PutObject/DeleteObject on the uploads bucket)

containerDefinitions.name: api

environment._comment: DEBUG=true would run create_all at boot and drift the schema away from the migrations. Never true here.
environment.name: DEBUG

environment._comment: Swagger/ReDoc stay reachable in production by decision (2026-09-23): they expose the route map, not access. Set false only if this API is ever placed on the open internet.
environment.name: DOCS_ENABLED

environment._comment: MIGRATIONS DO NOT RUN HERE. N tasks would race on the same revision. Run the kairox-migrate task first and wait for it to exit 0 — see README.md.
environment.name: RUN_MIGRATIONS

environment._comment: Gunicorn workers PER TASK. Multiply into the pool maths: tasks x WEB_CONCURRENCY x (DB_POOL_SIZE + DB_MAX_OVERFLOW) is what hits Postgres.
environment.name: WEB_CONCURRENCY

environment._comment: Fail fast under saturation rather than making callers wait SQLAlchemy's 30s default.
environment.name: DB_POOL_TIMEOUT

environment._comment: Below RDS Proxy's idle reaper, so the app never hands out a socket the server has closed.
environment.name: DB_POOL_RECYCLE

environment._comment: UNSET = EVERY FRONTEND REQUEST BLOCKED. Production fails closed on purpose.
environment.name: CORS_ORIGINS

environment._comment: Blank answers to ANY Host header, which is a cache-poisoning vector behind a balancer.
environment.name: TRUSTED_HOSTS

environment._comment: Dashboard read cache. Busted on write (core/cache.py), so a scan shows up immediately rather than after the TTL.
environment.name: CACHE_ENABLED

environment._comment: S3StorageBackend is already implemented (core/storage.py). Local disk breaks the moment there is more than one task.
environment.name: STORAGE_BACKEND

secrets._comment: Point BOTH at the RDS PROXY endpoint, not the instance.
secrets.name: DATABASE_URL

_healthcheck_comment: /ready, not /health. /health answers while degraded, which is right for
the ALB target group but wrong for a liveness decision — a task that
cannot reach the database should be replaced, not left in rotation.
